name: LeadPro standard package
source: [IN USE] LFMP Template / GHL Build (Andrew Cass)
fidelity: 13 Nov 2026: all 10 messages compared (normalized) with ZZ TEST 2's live GHL copy (read-only, handoff section 9). 9 match word for word; Email 1 differs only by GHL's stray space before a full stop (noted + checklist). Email 3's subject shows the firm name where GHL has [Insert Name Of Law Firm] (noted + checklist). Phone-lead branch emails = web-lead branch.

variants.consultation: Default. The template as it is: new-lead emails, consultation confirmation + reminders, reply alert.

workflows.ghl: GHL Build Out: Web Lead + Phone Lead

ghlMergeFields.{{location.name}}: Firm name (the sub-account's business name) in every body
ghlMergeFields.{{user.name}} / {{user.email}}: [Team member's name] / [Team member's email] (the assigned team member)

checklist: Fix Email 3 subject in GHL (replace [Insert Name Of Law Firm] with the firm name)
Check the sub-account's business name and phone in GHL settings (they fill {{location.name}} and {{location.phone}})
Put the client's real Zoom link in the 5 consultation messages (GHL has https://zoom.us/j/xyz)
Set up the booking calendar and point the consultation trigger at it
Fill or remove the email blanks: [XX] rating, [X]+ years, [Insert Case Study/Review]
Email 1: remove the stray space in "Thank you for choosing {{location.name}} ."
Check the sub-account's website in GHL settings (Email 3 uses {{location.website}})
Apply the client's answers on claims, phone number and sender
Send a test lead through before switching the 3 workflows on

placeholders.AGENCY: The record's Brand: LFMP or WPP (picks the header logo).
placeholders.AGENCY_NAME: Law Firm Marketing Pros or Web Promotion Partners.
placeholders.CODE: Client code: slug + '-' + 6 random [a-z0-9]. Also client.key.
placeholders.LOCATION: City, State (state written out, e.g. 'Louisville, Kentucky').
placeholders.SMS_HEALTHCARE: The record's smsHealthcare (true/false). Replaced by a real boolean, not text.
placeholders.REVIEWER: The record's primary contact name (first + last).
placeholders.PRACTICE_AREA: The record's practice area, or 'not set yet'.

carryOver.what: GHL sends Email 3 as "Why Choose [Insert Name Of Law Firm]?". The review shows the firm name (the client is told we'll fix it before go-live).
Email 3 promises "No Fee Unless You Win" and mentions decades of experience.

carryOver.question: phone-number
